methodology.title: How should I read this information?
methodology.description: The displayed time comes from the credited source and has the age shown here. Zero minutes means that a genuine zero wait was received; a dash means that no reliable time is available. Expired data is never presented as current.

forecast.title: Estimated wait from {{time}}
forecast.subtitle: This estimate only appears because the method proved more reliable than our reference on past data.
forecast.disclaimer: A forecast remains an estimate: attendance and operations can change quickly.

method.weekdayHourMedian: Median for the same weekday and hour

history.errorMessage: Current information remains available. You can retry the historical analysis only.
history.title: Typical wait by time of day
history.subtitle: These markers only describe past observations. They do not predict your wait on a future visit.

chart.label: Observed waits by local hour
chart.gapAria: At {{hour}}, there is not enough data.
chart.valueAria: At {{hour}}, the median wait is {{median}} minutes, with the middle half between {{firstQuartile}} and {{thirdQuartile}} minutes, based on {{observations}} observations across {{days}} days.

method.title: Method and excluded data
method.description: The median is less affected by exceptional days than an average. The middle half is the interquartile range; the typical range removes the lowest and highest 10% of values. Hours without enough evidence are deliberately left blank.
method.nonOperating: {{value}} observation excluded because the attraction was not operating
method.duplicates: {{value}} duplicate replaced by the latest reception
method.truncated: {{value}} observation comes from a time bucket that reached its storage limit, so the status remains cautious.
